questions.prompt: Which 1973 agreement helped end direct U.S. military involvement in Vietnam?
questions.fact: Signed in January 1973, the accords saw the last U.S. combat troops leave within months — though the war between North and South ran on until 1975.

questions.prompt: How many legs do adult insects have?
questions.fact: Six legs is part of the definition of an insect, not a coincidence. Spiders have eight, and are not insects at all.

questions.prompt: Which international tournament awards soccer's World Cup trophy?
questions.fact: The current trophy replaced one that was stolen twice: recovered by a dog in 1966, then taken again in 1983 and never seen since.

questions.prompt: Which actor played Princess Leia in Star Wars?
questions.fact: Fisher was 19 when she was cast, and went on to work as an uncredited script doctor across Hollywood.

questions.prompt: What famous diary was written while hiding during World War II?
questions.fact: Anne revised her own diary for publication after hearing a radio broadcast urging Dutch civilians to preserve their wartime writing.

questions.prompt: What is an AI chatbot designed to do?
questions.fact: Chatbots go back to 1966, when a program called ELIZA convinced some users it understood them simply by rephrasing their sentences as questions.
